DREAM SCHOOL ROUND 1 (2 minutes)
SAY: "Shout your ideas. What should the Dream School have? Anything at all. No wrong answers." As students shout ideas, TYPE the best 4-5 into Claude in real time. Something like:
"Describe a school for Class 6 and 7 students in rural India, 2047. This school has: [student idea 1], [student idea 2], [student idea 3], [student idea 4]. Describe it in vivid, exciting detail as if you were a journalist visiting it for the first time."
READ the AI response aloud to the class. Do this dramatically — with wonder and surprise in your voice. Even if you've read it before in testing. The students' reaction to hearing their ideas AMPLIFIED by AI is the magic moment.
ATTRIBUTION IS EVERYTHING: Say "This idea — the rooftop cricket ground — that came from... what's your name? Aarav! That's Aarav's idea that went into this school." Point to the student. They will glow.
Advance to Round 2.
